about: The catalogues of the koha.nexus SRU gateway, one per /sru/{id}. kind missing: no address known yet, so a search answers an SRU diagnostic saying so. To add one, give it kind z3950 (host, port, db, syntax USMARC or MARC21, encoding) or sru (url, version, schema, indexes) and restart the service. status says what is known about it: verified (searched live, MARC came back), untested, broken (its address does not answer) or missing. Discarded and not listed: DNB (its SRU gives only RDF/XML, not MARC21) and Cambridge (44CAM_INST is not a valid Alma institution). Logins go in the environment, never here: SRU_GATEWAY_LOGIN_<ID>=user:password.
